meanings.en: in place of something or someone
meanings.exampleEn: Let's walk instead of taking the bus.
meanings.exampleTr: Otobüse binmek yerine yürüyelim.

meanings.en: done without thinking, based on natural feeling
meanings.exampleEn: Her instinctive reaction was to protect the child.
meanings.exampleTr: İçgüdüsel tepkisi çocuğu korumak oldu.

meanings.en: in a way based on natural instinct rather than thought
meanings.exampleEn: He instinctively ducked when the ball flew towards him.
meanings.exampleTr: Top ona doğru uçunca içgüdüsel olarak eğildi.

meanings.en: very important in making something happen
meanings.exampleEn: She was instrumental in setting up the new department.
meanings.exampleTr: Yeni departmanın kurulmasında etkili bir rol oynadı.

meanings.en: performed with instruments only, without singing
meanings.exampleEn: The album includes several instrumental tracks.
meanings.exampleTr: Albümde birkaç enstrümantal parça var.

meanings.en: refusal to obey orders or authority
meanings.exampleEn: The soldier was punished for insubordination.
meanings.exampleTr: Asker itaatsizlik nedeniyle cezalandırıldı.

meanings.en: not large, solid or important
meanings.exampleEn: The evidence against him was insubstantial.
meanings.exampleTr: Aleyhindeki kanıtlar cılızdı.

meanings.en: to buy insurance so you get money if something is lost or damaged
meanings.exampleEn: We insured the house against fire and theft.
meanings.exampleTr: Evi yangına ve hırsızlığa karşı sigortaladık.

meanings.en: an organized attempt by a group to overthrow the government
meanings.exampleEn: The armed insurrection was quickly crushed by the army.
meanings.exampleTr: Silahlı ayaklanma ordu tarafından çabucak bastırıldı.

meanings.en: the process of combining people or things into one whole
meanings.exampleEn: The integration of immigrants into society takes time.
meanings.exampleTr: Göçmenlerin topluma entegrasyonu zaman alır.

meanings.en: the ability to think and understand ideas in a logical way
meanings.exampleEn: She is a woman of great intellect.
meanings.exampleTr: O, büyük zekaya sahip bir kadın.

meanings.en: able to be understood clearly
meanings.exampleEn: His speech was barely intelligible over the noise.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşması gürültünün üstünden zar zor anlaşılıyordu.

meanings.en: showing a lack of self-control, especially in speech or drinking
meanings.exampleEn: He was criticized for his intemperate remarks.
meanings.exampleTr: Ölçüsüz sözleri yüzünden eleştirildi.

meanings.en: a feeling of wanting to know about or take part in something
meanings.exampleEn: She has a keen interest in modern art.
meanings.exampleTr: Modern sanata büyük bir ilgisi var.

meanings.en: money paid for the use of borrowed money
meanings.exampleEn: The loan carries an interest rate of five percent.
meanings.exampleTr: Kredinin faiz oranı yüzde beş.

meanings.en: to say something suddenly, interrupting a conversation
meanings.exampleEn: "That's not true," she interjected.
meanings.exampleTr: "Bu doğru değil," diye araya girdi.

meanings.en: someone who becomes involved where they are not wanted
meanings.exampleEn: The locals treated the tourists as interlopers.
meanings.exampleTr: Yerliler turistlere davetsiz misafir muamelesi yaptı.

meanings.en: the belief that countries should work together for the common good
meanings.exampleEn: He was a lifelong advocate of internationalism and cooperation.
meanings.exampleTr: Hayatı boyunca enternasyonalizmi ve iş birliğini savundu.

meanings.tr: enternasyonalist, uluslararası iş birliğini savunan kişi
meanings.en: a person who believes countries should cooperate internationally
meanings.exampleEn: As an internationalist, she opposed closing the borders.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir enternasyonalist olarak sınırların kapatılmasına karşı çıktı.

meanings.en: buried a dead body (past tense of inter)
meanings.exampleEn: He was interred in the family vault.
meanings.exampleTr: Aile mezarlığına defnedildi.

meanings.en: the act of becoming involved in a situation to change it
meanings.exampleEn: Military intervention only made the conflict worse.
meanings.exampleTr: Askeri müdahale çatışmayı yalnızca kötüleştirdi.

meanings.en: a TV or radio show in which people are interviewed
meanings.exampleEn: She hosts a weekly interview programme on the radio.
meanings.exampleTr: Radyoda haftalık bir röportaj programı sunuyor.

meanings.en: a close and warm personal relationship
meanings.exampleEn: The intimacy between the two friends grew over the years.
meanings.exampleTr: İki arkadaş arasındaki yakınlık yıllar içinde arttı.

meanings.en: moving to the inside of a place or thing
meanings.exampleEn: She walked into the room and sat down.
meanings.exampleTr: Odaya girdi ve oturdu.

meanings.en: very interested in or keen on something
meanings.exampleEn: He's really into jazz these days.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu aralar caza gerçekten meraklı.

meanings.en: unwillingness to accept ideas or behaviour different from your own
meanings.exampleEn: The book condemns religious intolerance.
meanings.exampleTr: Kitap dini hoşgörüsüzlüğü kınıyor.

meanings.en: a condition of being unable to eat a food without becoming ill
meanings.exampleEn: She has a lactose intolerance.
meanings.exampleTr: Laktoz intoleransı var.

meanings.tr: tek düze bir sesle söylemek, ezgiyle okumak
meanings.en: to say something slowly in a level, often solemn voice
meanings.exampleEn: The priest intoned the words of the prayer.
meanings.exampleTr: Rahip duanın sözlerini ezgiyle okudu.

meanings.en: the state of being drunk or affected by a drug
meanings.exampleEn: He was arrested for driving in a state of intoxication.
meanings.exampleTr: Sarhoş halde araç kullanmaktan tutuklandı.

meanings.en: in a way that is part of the basic nature of something
meanings.exampleEn: There is nothing intrinsically wrong with the idea.
meanings.exampleTr: Fikirde özünde yanlış olan bir şey yok.

meanings.en: based on feelings rather than facts, or easy to use naturally
meanings.exampleEn: The software has a simple, intuitive interface.
meanings.exampleTr: Yazılımın basit, sezgisel bir arayüzü var.

meanings.en: to make something no longer valid or correct
meanings.exampleEn: A single error can invalidate the whole experiment.
meanings.exampleTr: Tek bir hata bütün deneyi geçersiz kılabilir.

meanings.en: the act of making something no longer valid
meanings.exampleEn: The invalidation of the contract cost them millions.
meanings.exampleTr: Sözleşmenin geçersiz kılınması onlara milyonlara mal oldu.

meanings.en: an animal without a backbone, such as an insect or worm
meanings.exampleEn: Insects are the largest group of invertebrates on Earth.
meanings.exampleTr: Böcekler dünyadaki en büyük omurgasız grubudur.

meanings.en: to make someone feel healthy and full of energy
meanings.exampleEn: A cold shower can invigorate you in the morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Soğuk bir duş sabahleyin seni canlandırabilir.

meanings.en: feeling full of energy and health
meanings.exampleEn: She felt invigorated after her morning run.
meanings.exampleTr: Sabah koşusundan sonra kendini dinç hissetti.

meanings.en: very angry
meanings.exampleEn: An irate customer demanded to see the manager.
meanings.exampleTr: Öfkeli bir müşteri müdürü görmek istedi.

meanings.en: a person who rejects reason as the basis of knowledge
meanings.exampleEn: Critics dismissed him as an irrationalist who ignored the evidence.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler onu kanıtları yok sayan bir irrasyonalist olarak nitelendirdi.

meanings.en: something that is not regular, even, or according to the rules
meanings.exampleEn: The audit revealed several financial irregularities.
meanings.exampleTr: Denetim birkaç mali usulsüzlüğü ortaya çıkardı.

meanings.en: not religious or showing no respect for religion
meanings.exampleEn: He grew up in an irreligious household.
meanings.exampleTr: Dinsiz bir evde büyüdü.

meanings.en: the state of being unable to make a decision
meanings.exampleEn: His irresolution cost the team a valuable opportunity.
meanings.exampleTr: Kararsızlığı takıma değerli bir fırsata mal oldu.

meanings.en: the fact of not thinking about the consequences of your actions
meanings.exampleEn: Leaving the children alone was an act of sheer irresponsibility.
meanings.exampleTr: Çocukları yalnız bırakmak tam bir sorumsuzluktu.

meanings.en: in a way that shows no thought about consequences
meanings.exampleEn: He behaved irresponsibly by spending all the money.
meanings.exampleTr: Bütün parayı harcayarak sorumsuzca davrandı.

meanings.en: not showing respect for things usually treated with respect
meanings.exampleEn: The comedian is known for his irreverent humour.
meanings.exampleTr: Komedyen saygısız mizahıyla tanınıyor.

meanings.tr: tahriş edici madde; rahatsız edici şey
meanings.en: a substance or thing that causes irritation or annoyance
meanings.exampleEn: Smoke is a common irritant to the eyes.
meanings.exampleTr: Duman gözler için yaygın bir tahriş edicidir.

meanings.en: to separate someone or something from others
meanings.exampleEn: Doctors decided to isolate the infected patients.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar enfekte hastaları izole etmeye karar verdi.

meanings.en: belonging to or connected with a thing or animal already mentioned
meanings.exampleEn: The dog wagged its tail happily.
meanings.exampleTr: Köpek kuyruğunu mutlulukla salladı.

meanings.en: used as the object referring to the same thing that is the subject
meanings.exampleEn: The cat cleaned itself in the sun.
meanings.exampleTr: Kedi güneşte kendini temizledi.
